messages:
support-jen: Hey team — customer on Private (v0.9.12) tried to generate a debug bundle and it fails during upload. Error seen: `upload failed: presign expired (403)` after ~4m. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. They captured the local curl attempt and the collector logs. Can someone post a short preflight checklist for them and the minimal repro steps we want?

samir: Thanks Jen. First things to confirm: collector version, system time/ntp, collector TZ vs S3 presign TTL, and whether they're behind an upload proxy. Quick commands: 
```
/usr/local/bin/ri-collector --version
timedatectl status
journalctl -u ri-collector -n 200 --no-pager
```
Ask them to paste only non-PII lines or upload the bundle to a secure support bucket.

alex: Also check service unit env for `PRESIGN_TTL` overrides. On older collectors we had a default 3m TTL in some builds. Command to show env: `systemctl show-environment | grep PRESIGN` or `cat /etc/systemd/system/ri-collector.service` if they modified it.

maria: If presign expired after 4m it's likely clock skew or TTL. Please have them run:
```
date -u && curl -I https://s3-presign.example.com/presign-url -v
```
Look for `x-amz-date` and expiry params in the presign URL (`X-Amz-Expires=`). If `X-Amz-Expires` is small (<300) and their clock is off by >60s upload can fail.

support-jen: They said their clocks are synced but their appliance had a 5m drift on the host container. They attached a tiny `curl` reproduction: 
```bash
curl -v -F "file=@/tmp/debug-req_0a1b2c3d.tar.gz" "https://presign-redwood.example/signed?X-Amz-Expires=240&..."
```
Response shows `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` and body: `The provided token has expired.`

samir: Good. Next repro we ask them to run locally (on the same host as collector) so we can rule out network/proxy: 
1) Generate a small bundle: `ri-collector bundle --generate --no-redact --out /tmp/bundle-test.tar.gz` (no-redact is safe for repro).
2) Try upload with curl and `-v` and `--trace-ascii trace.txt`. 
3) If presign fails, have them `sha256sum /tmp/bundle-test.tar.gz` and include the hex and file size.

alex: If the presign itself is issued by our control plane but the collector fails to use it, we sometimes see TLS interception by corporate proxies rewriting headers. Ask them to run: `curl -v --proxy-ntlm '' https://example.com` to see if a proxy responds. Also `env | grep -i proxy` on the collector host.

maria: For redaction mismatches: if they run the collector with custom redaction rules and later our redaction step removes fields referenced in the signed manifest, upload will be rejected by the ingest service (manifest checksum mismatch). Request they run the redaction dry-run locally: 
```
ri-redact --input /tmp/bundle-raw.tar.gz --rules /etc/ri/redact.d --dry-run --out /tmp/bundle-redacted.tar.gz
sha256sum /tmp/bundle-redacted.tar.gz
```
Compare to manifest sha256 in the presign payload (support can reissue presign if needed).

support-jen: They reported the manifest `sha256` in the control plane was `f5a1...7c2`. Our collector reported `f5a1...7c2` when uploaded locally but the control plane logged `mismatch: got f5a1...7d3` right before the 403. Suspect redaction plugin mutated the file between checksum calc and upload (race) or collector retried with a different file after TTL.

samir: Ask them to capture these logs immediately around bundle creation: 
```
journalctl -u ri-collector --since "5 minutes ago" -o short-iso | sed -n '1,200p'
cat /var/log/ri-collector/transfer.log | tail -n 200
```
Strip actual content from the logs before sharing in public thread. If they prefer, upload logs to our secure support bucket and DM the S3 path.

maria: If presign expiry is unavoidable, we can advise a scp fallback to support bastion for large bundles: 
```
scp /tmp/debug-req_0a1b2c3d.tar.gz support@bastion.redwood.internal:/incoming/req_0a1b2c3d/
```
We then pull from bastion into our ingest pipeline and mark the case as upload-fallback. This is slower but works around presign/TLS/proxy issues.

support-jen: I asked them to run the commands and to try scp fallback if curl keeps hitting 403. I also requested the following minimal artifacts: request ID, `trace.txt` from curl, `sha256sum`, `journalctl` excerpt, and the collector `--version` output.

sre-bot: Upload policy reminder: do not include raw user content or PII in thread. Use support private bucket or pastebin for redacted logs. :lock:

alex: Thanks — once they send the artifacts I'll triage. If we confirm TTL/clock skew we'll push a hotfix to increase local presign TTL to 10m on the next maintenance channel for Private appliances. :thumbsup:

support-jen: Copy — pinging customer to run the steps now. Will follow up with artifacts. Thanks all. :pray:
